item.description:
• Two playbooks that belong to the canonical Kit are put away on a personal install: the beta programme's intake, which reads a request queue your Kit does not have, and the adversarial review, whose reviewer lives on one machine only. Your Kit no longer offers the beta-request trigger as a live source, and asking it to run either playbook says why instead of failing.
  • Every playbook the canonical Kit keeps for itself now sits behind one check, so a future one cannot reach a personal install by accident.
